messages:
maria_marketing: hey @alex_runtime — quick favor. we're doing the webinar demo tomorrow at 10am PT. can you run a tiny bench/sanity on the demo payloads and confirm warmup behavior + fallback model routing won't skew lead routing? need p50/p95, any error spikes, and an artifact link we can attach to the press pack. also, need to confirm embeddings/rerank path latency since sales routing depends on it.

alex_runtime: got it. can you drop the exact payloads and the specific model variants we should hit? is this hosted or dedicated? also what's the SLO we should aim for?

maria_marketing: hosted. demo hits the 'chat' endpoint with function-calling (small mult-turn). payloads: 1) onboarding flow (~120 tokens), 2) long-context FAQ (~1600 tokens). models: prefer 'redwood-3b-v1' and fallback 'redwood-3b-quant' if capacity. SLO: p95 < 600ms for chat token streaming + end-to-end ~2s for short payloads. lead routing threshold: embeddings + rerank < 300ms extra.

alex_runtime: okay. i'll try a focused smoke with these two payloads. if fallback quant is used we'll report delta in quality/latency. can you confirm a stable example for the function call payload? need the exact JSON.

maria_marketing: example JSON here: https://drive.internal/runs/webinar-quickpack/demo-payloads.json

alex_runtime: perfect. running quick smoke now. command i'll use:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RL_TOKEN' \
  -d @demo-payload.json | jq '.metrics'
```

ci-deploy-bot: deploy finished: runtime/smoke-runner v2.3.1 to staging — started by alex_runtime

alex_runtime: smoke finished. short summary: p50=220ms, p95=560ms for short payloads; long-context p50=1.2s, p95=2.6s (KV warmup matters). fallback quant: short p95=640ms (+80ms), quality delta: negligible for this demo but will attach sample outputs. embeddings/rerank path measured additional 240ms median.

sam_product: thanks — for lead routing, does that 240ms bump include vector DB time? we need to know where to budget latency on the UI path.

alex_runtime: yes that includes embedding call + local rerank (no external DB). if you add an external DB call expect +60-120ms depending on region.

jules_marketing: alex can you upload the raw run artifacts (logs, raw outputs, the exact command/scripts) to the marketing folder? we'll link it to the press kit.

alex_runtime: uploading now to https://drive.internal/runs/webinar-quickpack/1765432129-artifacts.zip

maria_marketing: beautiful. last ask — can you add a short note listing assumptions (warmup duration, concurrency during smoke, token limits) so we can include reconciliation notes?

alex_runtime: note added to the artifact. warmup: 2x short payloads streamed before capture; concurrency=1 for deterministic tail; token limit=2048 for long payload. I'll re-run once more 15m before the demo.

maria_marketing: awesome, huge help :thumbsup:

sam_product: flagged to infra — if we hit issues during live demo we fall back to pre-recorded clip and route leads to form. putting a checklist in the webinar runbook.

alex_runtime: copy that. will ping if anything changes.
